text.tspan: 11.Remove the top cover. Place the accessory cover with the hard disk
sideways beside the computer. Install the hard disk cable by threading it
through the opening in the top cover for the accessory cover. Make sure
the connector plug in the cable lines up with the missing pin of JA00 on
the main PCB as shown in Figure 4. Gently push the hard disk cable
partially onto JA00. Make sure the connector pins of JA00 are lined up
with the socket connector on the hard disk cable. Now push firmly down
on the hard disk cable until the connectors are fully engaged.
12.Locate the power supply cable as shown in Figure 4. It may be tied or
fastened. Untie it and pull it over to the right side of the computer far
enough to clear the opening in the top cover for the accessory cover as
13.Connect the power supply extension cable on the hard disk to the power
supply cable in the computer. Make sure the colored wires in both
14.Install the accessory cover. Carefully fold the hard disk cable and the
power supply cable so they fit neatly behind the hard disk drive. Lower the
front of the accessory cover down onto the top cover until it fits flush
15.Re-connect the monitor, keyboard, and power cable.
